The Halden Vantapoint

A reconstructed studio-museum of Mira Solveig Halden — an entire building rendered in your browser from nothing but CSS 3D transforms. No WebGL, no plugins. Walk through four rooms of kinetic-light works that slow weather down enough to look at.
